title: plotagents spec
description: Declarative chart spec. Data as rows (tidy) plus the field name for each role. Everything else has well-designed defaults. `data` is required except for kpi (`items`), flowchart (`nodes` + `edges`), chord (`matrix`) and wordcloud with raw `text`.

type.description: Compare: bar, count. Time: line, area. Schedules: gantt. Relationships: scatter, bubble, regplot, residplot, jointplot, radar, corr (correlation matrix; clustermap), pairplot (scatter-plot matrix). Distributions (seaborn): hist, kde, ecdf, box, violin, strip, swarm, point. Part-to-whole: treemap, sunburst, donut, pie. Other: heatmap, sankey, kpi, network, chord, pyramid, flowchart, wordcloud. Maps: choropleth, symbolmap, pointmap (lat/lon dots over a tile basemap). seaborn names are accepted (barplot, countplot, histplot, kdeplot, boxplot, violinplot, lmplot…). "auto" (default) picks from the data.

data.description: Array of rows, e.g. [{ "region": "Biobío", "sales": 1240 }]. For kpi it can be omitted in favor of `items`.

title.description: The finding as a full sentence, ideally with the key number, e.g. "Biobío accounts for 32% of sales".

subtitle.description: How to read the chart: measure, unit and period, e.g. "Sales by region, CLP millions, 2025".

source.description: Data source, shown at the bottom right.

locale.description: Language and number format. Default "es" (1.234,5); "en" for 1,234.5; also "pt", "fr", "de". "auto" recognizes the language from the title, subtitle, column names and categories (tables do this when `locale` is omitted).

x.description: x-axis or category field (bar, line, area, scatter, heatmap, box, violin…).

y.description: Value field. For line/bar a list of fields (wide table) turns each one into a series.

series.description: Field that splits the data into colored series. Alias: hue.

color.description: Alias of series when it names a field (a "#hex" value is a fixed color instead).

value.description: Value field for treemap, sunburst, donut, heatmap, sankey and radar.

label.description: Name field (treemap, donut, point labels in scatter/regplot).

group.description: Level-1 group field for a two-level treemap (shortcut for path). gantt: phase/workstream field (one colored section per phase). table: rows grouped under a header per value.

path.description: Hierarchy for treemap/sunburst, any depth: [level1, level2, …].

axis.description: radar: field with the axis names (long format).

axes.description: radar: fields to use as axes (wide format, one row per series).

previous.description: Previous value; when given, the change is computed.

period.description: What it is compared against, e.g. "vs 2025".

good.description: Whether going up is good (up) or bad (down, e.g. costs).

text.description: wordcloud: field with the words, OR the raw text to count (a string or a list of strings, e.g. open survey answers). Raw text drops Spanish/English stopwords.

textField.description: wordcloud: field holding free text in each row; words are counted across rows.

stopwords.description: wordcloud: extra words to ignore when counting raw text.

maxFont.description: wordcloud: largest font size (default from the panel size).

task.description: gantt: task name field (one row per task).

start.description: gantt: start date field ("2026-03-02", "2026-03") or a number (e.g. week).

end.description: gantt: end date field. Day dates are inclusive. Missing end, or end equal to start, makes a milestone.

duration.description: gantt: duration field (days, or units of a numeric axis) instead of `end`.

progress.description: gantt: completion field, 0–1 or 0–100. The filled part of each bar is the progress.

dependsOn.description: gantt: field with the name(s) of the predecessor task(s) ("A" or "A, B"): draws arrows.

milestone.description: gantt: boolean field that marks milestones (drawn as diamonds).

today.description: gantt: date of the "today" line ("2026-03-12"), or true for the current date.

groupHeaders.description: gantt: false draws phases as a color legend instead of section headers.

collapsed.description: gantt: phases (values of `group`) drawn collapsed into one summary row; true collapses all. In the browser a click on a phase header toggles it.

collapsible.description: gantt: false disables click-to-collapse of phases in the browser.

critical.description: gantt: highlight the critical path, the zero-slack chain along `dependsOn`.

criticalColor.description: gantt: color of the critical path.

weekends.description: gantt: shade weekends on day plans of up to 120 days (default true).

sort.description: bar: category order (desc by default unless the categories are time). gantt: "start" orders tasks by start date. donut/chord: "none" keeps the data order.

geo.description: choropleth/symbolmap: "chile" (16 regions, default), "usa" (50 states + DC, Albers with Alaska/Hawaii insets; Puerto Rico when it has data), "world" (countries), a name registered with registerGeo(), or YOUR OWN geometry: a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature, list of Features or bare geometry, or a TopoJSON Topology. Polygons are filled, LineStrings stroked and Points drawn as dots. In the browser, render() also accepts a URL to a .geojson/.topojson file.

geoObject.description: TopoJSON: name of the object inside `objects` to draw (default: the first one).

key.description: choropleth/symbolmap: data field with the region, state or country name/code to match (US: "TX", "Texas", "06").

projection.description: Map projection (picked automatically): "mercator", "equalEarth", "albersUsa", "equirectangular", "conic" (or { type: "conic", parallels: [-30, -45], rotate: 72 }), "identity" (coordinates already in pixels, y down) or "planar" (projected coordinates such as UTM metres, y up; chosen automatically when coordinates are outside lon/lat range).

values.description: choropleth with state codes (usa): false shows only the codes, without values.

featureKey.description: choropleth: feature property to match `key` against. Default tries code, id, ISO-3, name and aliases, then any property whose values match the data (e.g. "CUT_REG", "GEOID").

nameKey.description: choropleth: feature property with the display name (default: name, NOMBRE, NAME_1, ADMIN…).

fitTo.description: Map framing: zoom to some regions (names or codes), a bounding box [lonMin, latMin, lonMax, latMax], or "markers". The rest of the map stays as context, clipped.

markers.description: Map: points on top, from [{ lon, lat, label, value?, color? }] or { data, lon, lat, label, size, color, legend, maxRadius, labels }. With a size field, circles are area-proportional.

layers.description: Map: extra GeoJSON drawn over (or `below: true` under) the regions: rivers, roads, routes, borders, points. Each { geo, label?, stroke?, width?, fill?, dash?, opacity?, below? }; a `label` adds a legend key.

borderColor.description: Map: color of the borders between regions.

borderWidth.description: Map: width of the borders between regions.

pointRadius.description: Map: radius of Point features in your own GeoJSON (default 5).

missing.description: choropleth: how regions without data look: hatched (default) or "plain" (flat tint).

thresholds.description: choropleth: class breaks (same as a list in `scale`).

lat.description: pointmap: latitude field (auto-detected: lat, latitude, latitud).

lon.description: pointmap: longitude field (auto-detected: lon, lng, longitude, longitud).

tiles.description: pointmap: basemap. "osm" (default), "esri-gray", "esri-dark", "carto-light", "carto-dark", "mapbox-light", "mapbox-dark" (needs `tilesKey`), your own { url, attribution, subdomains, maxZoom, retina } with {z}/{x}/{y}, or false for none (vector world outline).

tilesKey.description: pointmap: API key or PUBLIC token for the tile provider (Mapbox "pk.…"; a secret "sk." token is rejected because it would be visible in the SVG).

tileStyle.description: pointmap: "muted" (default) desaturates the basemap so the data stands out; "original" keeps its colors.

zoom.description: pointmap: tile zoom level (automatic from the points by default).

center.description: pointmap: map center [lon, lat] (default: fitted to the points).

tall.description: Map: false prevents the tall layout (map on the left, ranked label column on the right) for elongated territories.

midpoint.description: choropleth/heatmap: diverging color scale around this value (e.g. 0 for changes).

scale.description: choropleth: "quantile" (default), "equal", "continuous", "categorical" (text values get one color each; automatic when `value` holds text) or a list of thresholds.

nodes.description: network: node rows (id, group, size). flowchart: steps (id, label, type: start|end|process|decision|data|note, lane).

edges.description: flowchart: connections (from, to, label). Same as `data`.

layout.description: network layout: "force" (default) deterministic force-directed; "circular" around a circle by group with names rotated outward ("circle" = circular); "radial" tree rings from `focus` or the most connected node; "concentric" rings by weight; "clusters" one cluster per group; "tree" the radial tree laid flat; "grid" ordered by group.

curveness.description: network: edge bend as a share of its length (default 0.3; 0 = straight).

maxRadius.description: network/symbolmap/pointmap/bubble: largest node or circle radius in px.

nodeLabel.description: network: label field in `nodes` (default label, else the id).

labelOrientation.description: chord: label orientation (radial by default above 10 groups).

ribbonColor.description: chord: ribbon color: "source" (default when directed), "smaller" group (default) or "larger" flow.

directed.description: chord: treat flows as directed (default false).

direction.description: flowchart: top-to-bottom or left-to-right (automatic by default).

sex.description: pyramid: field with exactly two sides (e.g. sex).

percent.description: pyramid: show shares of the total population.

facet.description: One panel per value of this field (small multiples, seaborn col). Shared scales and colors.

facetOrder.description: facet: panel order (values of the facet field; the rest follow).

columns.description: table: the columns, in order: field names or objects { field, label, type, format, align, width, good, target, colorScale, total, lines }. Column types: text, number, bar (data bar), heat (cell color), delta (▲/▼ change, colored by `good`), sparkline (field holds a list of numbers), progress (meter vs `target` field/number, or 0–1 / 0–100), badge (status pill; status words in es/en/pt/fr/de get good/warning/critical colors), check (booleans as ✓), date, link, rank. Omit to infer everything. facet: panels per row (an integer, seaborn col_wrap). kpi: tiles per row.

text.description: link: field with the text to show instead of the URL.

sortBy.description: table: column to sort by (field or label). Numbers sort high→low by default, text A→Z. In the browser a click on a header sorts.

pageSize.description: table: rows per page. Default: all rows up to 15, then pages of 10. false shows every row.

page.description: table: page to show (1-based). In the browser the pager changes it.

query.description: table: show only rows that contain these words (accent- and case-insensitive).

search.description: table: search box in the browser (default: on above 20 rows).

total.description: table: totals row. true sums numbers (and averages percents and progress); "mean"/"sum"; or { field: "sum" | "mean" | false, label }.

totalLabel.description: table: label of the totals row (default "Total"/"Gesamt").

rank.description: table: add a "#" column with the position under the current sort.

cards.description: table: one card per row. "auto" (default) switches when the columns do not fit (phones); true always; false never (columns shrink and truncate).

striped.description: table: tint every other row (helps on very wide tables).

bars.description: table: false turns off the automatic data bar on the main numeric column.

sortable.description: table: false disables click-to-sort on headers in the browser.

sharex.description: facet: same x scale in every panel (default true).

panelHeight.description: facet: height of each panel in px.

sharey.description: facet: same y scale in every panel (default true).

time.description: Time field (d3plus-style): shows one period at a time (the latest by default, or `timeValue`). Add `slider: true` only when the person asks to move through periods.

timeValue.description: Period to show when `time` is set.

slider.description: Browser time controls, OFF by default; set them only when the person asks. true: period buttons when there are few periods (≤ 8), a minimal slider otherwise; line/area get a range slider. "buttons" or "slider" force one.

play.description: Browser: false keeps the time controls but hides the play button.

playInterval.description: Browser: milliseconds per period while playing.

legend.description: Legend: true/false, or its position "top" (default), "bottom", "left", "right" (left/right fall back to bottom under 520px wide), or { position }.

legendTitle.description: Title of a color-ramp or size legend (heatmap, maps).

exclude.description: Drop legend entries (series, first hierarchy level, group or donut slice) and recompute axes and shares with the rest. Colors stay fixed; excluded entries remain in the legend, faded, so a click re-adds them. In the browser shift+click on a legend key toggles it.

compare.description: With `time`: period to compute changes against: "previous" (default), "first", a specific period, or false.

colorBy.description: treemap: "change" colors tiles by % change vs the comparison period (diverging, growth cool / decline warm); "label" colors a single-level treemap by item.

shade.description: treemap/sunburst: subtle lightness steps inside each category (default false: one solid color per category).

xRange.description: line/area: visible x range [from, to] (what the range slider sets with `slider: true`).

showValues.description: treemap: show each tile value next to its label.

hole.description: sunburst: size of the center hole as a fraction of the radius (default 0.3).

focus.description: treemap/sunburst: path to drill into, e.g. ["Mining"] (in the browser a click on a tile or legend key zooms to it). network: a node id to center and highlight with its neighbors.

depth.description: treemap/sunburst: how many levels to show.

valueDomain.description: box/violin/strip/swarm/point/radar: fixed value-axis domain [min, max] whatever the orientation.

zero.description: line: force (or prevent) a y axis starting at zero.

yLabel.description: y-axis title (drawn horizontally above the axis).

format.description: Value format: "number" | "compact" | "percent" | "currency" | "integer", or { type, prefix, suffix, decimals (0–20), currency }.

xFormat.description: Format of x values when x is a measure (scatter, regplot, hist).

yFormat.description: Format of y values (overrides `format` on the y axis).

highlight.description: Emphasize one or more categories/series and mute the rest. table: the rows whose label matches.

dashed.description: Draw some shapes dashed (hatched fill + dashed outline; dashed stroke for lines) to mark estimates, projections or provisional figures. A category/series/region name or a list of them, a data field whose truthy rows are dashed, { field, equals }, or true for all.

dashedFrom.description: line/area/bar on a time axis: x value from which marks are dashed (a projection). Lines turn dashed from the last firm point, over a soft labeled band.

dashedLabel.description: What the dashed shapes mean ("Projection", "Preliminary"): legend entry, band label and tooltip line. false hides the band label.

labels.description: Value labels: true, false or "auto". In scatter/regplot: a number of points or a list of names to label. network: true labels every node.

annotations.description: line/area: events on the x axis.

horizontal.description: Force horizontal orientation (otherwise chosen from label length and count).

top.description: bar: keep the N largest and fold the rest into "Other". table: keep the first N rows after sorting.

endLabels.description: line/regplot: false removes the series names at the end of each line (a legend is drawn instead).

labelsFor.description: Wide table (y as a list): display names per column, e.g. { "rev": "Revenue" }.

index.description: line: rebase each series to 100 at its first value (compare growth without a dual axis).

aggregate.description: How to combine repeated rows. Default sum.

ci.description: line/bar/regplot: confidence interval (true = 95, or a number). In line/bar it switches the estimator to the mean.

estimator.description: How to summarize several observations per category.

stat.description: hist: what the y axis measures.

multiple.description: hist/kde with hue: how groups are combined.

fill.description: kde: fill the area. line: false removes the gradient under a single line.

order.description: regplot: polynomial degree (number). box/violin/strip/swarm/point: category order (list). corr: variable order (list).

lowess.description: regplot: local regression instead of a straight line.

logx.description: regplot: fit y ~ log(x) with a log x axis.

trend.description: scatter: add a least-squares line and R².

kind.description: jointplot: center plot. pairplot: "reg" adds a least-squares line to every scatter panel.

bwAdjust.description: kde/violin/hist kde: multiply the bandwidth (seaborn bw_adjust).

cut.description: kde/violin: how far the density extends past the data, in bandwidths.

jitter.description: strip: spread of the points across the category (fraction of the band, default 0.6; 0 or false = none).

dodge.description: strip/swarm/point with hue: place groups side by side.

rug.description: kde: tick marks for each observation.

complementary.description: ecdf: show 1 − F(x) (share above each value).

radius.description: Point radius in px (scatter, regplot, strip, swarm).

split.description: violin: with two hue levels, one half each.

points.description: box: overlay the observations. line: markers on every point.

normalize.description: radar: scale each axis 0–1 by its own maximum.

thickness.description: donut: ring thickness as a fraction of the radius (1 = pie).

maxSlices.description: donut/pie: slices before the rest fold into "Other" (default 6).

centerValue.description: donut/sunburst: text in the center (default: the total).

centerLabel.description: donut/sunburst: caption under the center value.

cellHeight.description: heatmap: maximum cell height in px.

vars.description: corr/pairplot: the numeric fields to relate, in order (seaborn `vars`). Default: every numeric field (pairplot: the first 6). `y: [...]` works too.

method.description: corr: correlation coefficient. "pearson" (default, linear) or "spearman" (ranks: monotonic relations, robust to outliers).

triangle.description: corr: "lower" (default) shows each pair once, below the diagonal; "full" shows the whole symmetric matrix (default with `cluster`).

cluster.description: corr: reorder variables by hierarchical clustering (average linkage on 1 − r) and draw the dendrogram on top, like sns.clustermap. `type: "clustermap"` sets it.

dendrogram.description: corr with `cluster`: false hides the dendrogram but keeps the clustered order.

alpha.description: corr: significance level (e.g. 0.05). Cells with p ≥ alpha are greyed out and a legend key explains it. p-values use Fisher's z.

cellSize.description: corr: maximum cell size in px (cells are square).

diag.description: pairplot: what goes on the diagonal. Default "hist", or "kde" when `hue` is set.

upper.description: pairplot: above the diagonal, "corr" (default: Pearson r, tinted by strength, per `hue` group when there is room), "scatter" (mirror), or false (empty).

corner.description: pairplot: draw only the lower triangle and the diagonal (seaborn corner=True).

panelSize.description: pairplot: maximum panel size in px.

palette.description: Categorical colors: a name ("cdia", "okabe-ito", "tableau10", "udec"), a matplotlib qualitative palette ("tab10", "tab20", "Set1", "Set2", "Set3", "Pastel1", "Pastel2", "Paired", "Accent", "Dark2"), any colormap name (sampled, e.g. "viridis"), or a list of colors in fixed order.

ramp.description: Sequential ramp: a name ("indigo", "magenta", "teal", "amber"), any colormap name, or a list of colors from light to dark.

colorScale.description: Continuous color scale (heatmap, choropleth, treemap change, pointmap values): any matplotlib colormap name, case-insensitive, `_r` reverses ("viridis", "plasma", "inferno", "magma", "cividis", "Blues", "Greens", "YlOrRd", "RdBu", "coolwarm", "Spectral", "turbo", "twilight"…); diverging names imply a diverging scale. Or a list of hex colors, or { name | colors, reverse, mid }. Aliases: cmap, colormap. Qualitative palettes (tab10…) go in `palette`; avoid rainbow maps (jet, hsv).

theme.description: Theme: "papel" (light, default), "noche" (dark), a name registered with registerTheme(), or a JSON object deep-merged over `extends`. Simple tokens: background (alias of surface), text (alias of ink), accent (first series color), grid (a color or { color, dash, width }), axis, tooltip { bg, ink }, radius / barRadius (corner radius), font. Full keys: surface, ink, lede, muted, tint, dim, other, categorical (list, palette or colormap name), sequential, diverging, status {good, warning, critical}, font {family, mono, import}, type {title, subtitle, label, axis, legend, source, titleWeight}, marks {barRadius, barMax, lineWidth, pointRadius, gap, ring, areaOpacity, bandOpacity, dotOpacity}, axes {inside, grid}, layout {padding}. configure({ theme }) applies it to every chart.

font.description: Typeface for the whole chart: a Google Fonts name ("Poppins"), a CSS stack ("'Inter', sans-serif") or { family, import }. configure({ font }) sets it for every chart.

textScale.description: Multiplies every text size (1.5, 2…); the layout is recomputed so nothing overlaps. Aliases: fontScale, labelScale. configure({ textScale }) sets it for every chart.

width.description: Width in px (default 720; render() uses the container width).

height.description: Height in px. Automatic for horizontal bars, heatmaps, KPI tiles, and narrow treemaps, sunbursts and radars.

padding.description: Outer padding in px (default from the width).
